article: For each question, write the correct answer. My travel blog This summer, I travelled to Copenhagen, the capital of Denmark, on my own. I am only 20 and to (27)…………… honest, I was nervous about exploring a new city alone. I decided to go on a free walking tour the first day I was there. I hoped the tour would help me to become more familiar (28)…………… the city.  Unfortunately, the weather wasn't great, but the tour was still absolutely fantastic! Magnus, our tour guide, knew all about the city's history. We also learnt lots (29)…………… interesting facts about Danish culture. At the end of the tour, he gave (30)…………… all suggestions for the best places (31)…………… eat and visit.  Apart from learning so much, I actually had a lot more fun on the walking tour (32)…………… I expected. It was an excellent way to experience the city, and learn about its culture and history.

explanations.27:
原因：“to be honest” 固定短语，表 “说实话”。
语法点：插入语 to be honest，类似如 to tell the truth。
explanations.28:
原因：“become familiar with” 固定搭配，表 “熟悉”。
语法点：be/become familiar with sth.，如 “I am familiar with this song.”
explanations.29:
原因：“lots of” 固定搭配，表 “许多”。
词汇点：lots of + 可数 / 不可数名词，如 lots of books/time。
explanations.30:
原因：give 后接宾格 “us”，指代 “我们”。
语法点：双宾语结构 give sb. sth.，如 give me a book。
explanations.31:
原因：不定式 “to eat” 作后置定语，修饰 places。
语法点：the best places to do sth.，如 a good place to live。
explanations.32:
原因：比较级 “more fun than expected”，表 “比预期更有趣”。
语法点：more...than... 比较结构，如 faster than a car。
